claims.text: The toolbar, filters, actions, progress, coverage and warning and error blocks style ledger controls and banners.
The event spine, cards, dot markers, hash and payload blocks, pagination and verification sections present journal history.
Narrow breakpoints stack the filters and compact padding while wrapping rules keep operation and payload text readable.

decision.rule: Change here when the ledger toolbar, timeline cards or payload blocks need to change.
decision.failure: Events become unreadable, hashes overflow, or filters misalign on narrow screens.

questions.q: Where are the ledger timeline spine and event card styles defined?
Where should I change the hash and payload block styling?
Where can I debug why ledger filters misalign on narrow screens?
